dn32:12.4: Seated to one side, mendicants, the Great King Vessavaṇa said to me,
dn32:12.5: ‘Sir, some high spirits have no confidence in the Buddha … some low spirits have confidence in the Buddha.
dn32:12.6: But mostly the spirits don’t have confidence in the Buddha.
dn32:12.8: Because the Buddha teaches them to refrain from killing living creatures … and consuming intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor.
dn32:12.9: But mostly the spirits don’t refrain from killing living creatures … or from consuming intoxicants of beer, wine, and liquor.
dn32:12.10: They don’t like that or approve of it.
dn32:12.11: Sir, there are disciples of the Buddha who frequent remote lodgings in the wilderness and the forest that are quiet and still, far from the madding crowd, remote from human settlements, and fit for retreat.
dn32:12.12: There dwell high spirits who have no confidence in the Buddha’s dispensation. To give them confidence, may the Buddha please learn the Āṭānāṭiya protection for the guarding, protection, safety, and comfort of the monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen.’

dn32:12.231: This, good fellow, is the Āṭānāṭiya protection for the guarding, protection, safety, and comfort of the monks, nuns, laymen, and laywomen.
dn32:12.232: Suppose a monk, nun, layman, or laywoman has learned this Āṭānāṭiya protection well and completely memorized it. If any non-human being—a male or female spirit … a male or female centaur … a male or female gnome … a male or female dragon, a dragon boy or girl, a dragon chief minister, councillor, or servant—were to approach that monk, nun, layman, or laywoman with malicious intent while they are walking, standing, sitting, or lying down—
dn32:12.233: that non-human will receive no homage or respect in any village or town.
dn32:12.234: And they will receive no ground or dwelling in my capital of Ālakamandā.
dn32:12.235: Nor will they get to go to the conference of the spirits.
dn32:12.236: In addition, the non-humans would not give or take them in marriage.
dn32:12.237: They’d heap personal abuse on them,
dn32:12.238: drop an empty bowl on their head,
dn32:12.239: and even split their head into seven pieces!
